title: 千里眼の手動起動 R1

producer.semantics: Activation returns true after active playing, alive, non-ejected, outside vent, conscious, positive mana checks and state commit. A repeated true request can return true. Manual OFF→ON is proven by explicit preview fixture fields, not inferred from an active snapshot.

design.subject: A small six-blade brass viewing aperture opens on a new acknowledged manual activation. As the blades slide tangentially apart, amber glass is uncovered and a stationary catchlight seats at full opening.
design.scale: 86 CSS px outer diameter at full logical scale, blade seams terminate at the aperture. Reduced motion removes angular travel of the assembly.
design.postEffect: Local aperture occlusion and a bounded central catchlight; no remote scene or fullscreen flash.
design.audio: A friction sweep tracks blade travel, then a decaying two-part detent at 515 ms. Verification mode forcibly muted.

scope: Local manual fixture only. Repeated ON request, snapshot, denied, OFF, foreign and stale acknowledgements yield idle. The host does not receive any target/position, remote view, stored identity or credentials. Main-game activation, persistent marker, throw/teleport, mana drain and depletion are untouched.

validation.bounded: Gate tests on seven UI cases, unknown fixture, duplicate/out-of-order/invalid ids, foreign getter short circuit and positive allowlisted projection; host syntax and control list checked.
validation.audio: PCM tested at four rates for finite values, two scheduled peaks, silence at ends and maximum level.
validation.runtimeReadback: 4/4 exact source text and Git blob checks at immutable runtime commit
